lit-code.reason: The OpenCode lit-code port intentionally ships a focused four-language reference set for its static route; richer sibling packages include additional host-specific stack and generator material that OpenCode does not bind, so this reduced native closure is an explicit reviewed divergence.

lit-fetch.reason: The rename joins a shared ID with a twelve-file standalone reader port. OpenCode retains its complete single-file skill contract backed by the packaged fetchPublicSource runtime, CLI fetch-public, SSRF guards, and source tests; copying the other host implementation would duplicate this native runtime.

lit-korean.reason: Other host ports retain this legacy prose-skill id. LitOpenCode replaced its former single-file skill with the independently packaged lit-humanizer contract, detector, managed assets, and native write guard; the older cross-product row remains for products that still ship the prior id.

skills.agent-roster: The file defines the native agent registry, role boundaries, routing, and safety contract; runtime code is packaged separately.
skills.lit-burnoff-file: It gives a complete post-edit cleanup taxonomy, triage, safety, and verification contract tied to native hooks.
skills.comment-checker: Comment intent, accuracy, necessity, maintenance checks, and the after-tool binding are fully described in one file.
skills.deep-interview: The command and agent route, decision questions, approval state, and readiness output form a complete procedure.
skills.doctor-installer: CLI doctor and install inspection, config roots, managed files, failure modes, and evidence are bounded without a corpus.
skills.durable-litgoal: The skill binds the packaged goal operations and ledger symbols, whose compiled runtime is present in the product payload.
skills.lit-commit: Native command routing plus bounded Git inventory, isolation, diff, history, and remote safety are complete in the body.
skills.lit-crucible: Parallel delegation, exploration, contradiction checks, synthesis, and planning handoff form a complete native procedure.
skills.lit-init: Repository discovery, instruction placement, complexity decisions, conflict analysis, and verification are fully specified.
skills.lit-recap: The read-only recap contract covers current repo and ledger state, evidence hierarchy, stale claims, and output format.
skills.litresearch: Research commands and exported retrieval APIs are mapped with source, safety, and report contracts in the instruction.
skills.litwork: The document is a complete static hook and route contract backed by packaged command, tool, and feature runtime bindings.
skills.lsp: It states that no server is bundled and gives the host-capability probe, diagnostics workflow, and fallback evidence.
skills.native-goal-verdict: The verdict procedure is backed by the packaged durable ledger and native status surfaces named in the document.
skills.lit-fetch: The exported fetch route, URL and content safety, redaction, and verification contract are complete instructions.
skills.refactor: Command routing, characterization, structural strategy, safety, verification, and rollback are fully bounded in one file.
skills.reference-benchmark-claims: Benchmark and claim classes, evidence requirements, and packaged claim-guard APIs are completely specified.
skills.release-guardrails: Release freeze, version and pack checks, scanners, host boundaries, and evidence requirements form a full contract.
skills.lit-burnoff: Test locking, cleanup categories, meaning preservation, native routes, safety, and verification are fully specified.
skills.review-work: Plan and completion review modes, evidence lanes, DoneClaim challenge, and native routes are all bounded.
skills.rules: Native rule discovery, precedence, hook binding, static and dynamic lanes, and verification are completely described.
skills.search-workflow-ideas: The exported workflow catalog and lookup surfaces support the bounded search, safety, and reporting procedure.
skills.start-work: Approved-plan loading, authority and lifecycle gates, native command routes, evidence, and cleanup are fully specified.
skills.structural-search: Capability detection, lexical fallback, host-tool limits, structural questions, and evidence are complete and honest.
skills.tool-guards: The document names the packaged guard module and hook contract, which supply the implementation for its bounded behavior.
skills.workflow-loop: The runtime-class contract and cycle, authority, evidence, and stop rules map to the packaged workflow runtime.
